title: Allgemeinverfügungen erlassen – Einschränkungen im Bezirk Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf

extraction.summaryEn: Police issued a temporary general order banning carrying weapons and knives from 7:00 to 16:30 on 19 April 2026 in an area around the Olympiastadion during the S25 running event. The order is a precaution and reports no incident.
